answer_1.quote: We propose a novel single-stage joint speech-text SFT approach for training SpeechLMs using LoRA adapters. This method simplifies the training process, preserves the text-only performance of the LLM backbone, and achieves excellent speech understanding capabilities.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text responses conditioned on speech and/or text inputs, including transcriptions, translations, answers to questions, and formatted outputs such as JSON.

answer_2.quote: For ASR and AST, we use standard multilingual benchmarks, namely Common Voice  and FLEURS . We normalize the text using Whisper's normalizers  before computing the Word Error Rate (WER).

answer_3.quote: As described in Section 4.1, we use OpenAI's GPT APIs to evaluate SQA tasks. For the public benchmark AIR-Bench , we follow the standard evaluation script with gpt-4-0125-preview. For the other two test sets, APGI and SQuAD2, we use a more recent API, gpt-4o-2024-08-06, with the following prompt template.
